# CV Axles and Boot Replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace the CV axle and boot by mounting the inner half in a vise. [t357]

## Parts

- CV Axle: OEM or Aftermarket, e.g., Duralast [t357]
- [Partial] Replacement Boot Kit: Nissan kit to regrease and reinstall original axle [t357]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a wood block between the hammer and the boot if you don't have a brass hammer. [t357]
- Swap an aftermarket C-clip with a smoother edge onto the axle end to prevent binding in the differential. [t357]

## Common mistakes

- Pulling the inner CV joint apart without removing the protective clip first, risking damage inside the boot. [t357]
- Struggling to seat the outer joint due to rough edges on an aftermarket C-clip. [t357]
